name: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lore: Mesha records Gate behavior from within a bronze observatory built around an inactive solar pylon. She never enters strike force play; her purpose is to preserve canon, interpret ancient signs, and warn the Creator when sacred order is about to fail.
personality: Precise, severe, loyal to truth over comfort.
physicalDescription: Tall ceremonial scribe silhouette in gold-lacquered linen armor, obsidian stylus, sun-disc visor, amber-glowing tablet.
gameplayFunction: Tutorial narrator, codex unlock source, objective briefing voice.

name: Hrodda Oath-Witness
lore: Hrodda preserves the names of Titans who survive impossible Gate storms. She tests whether a mission objective is worthy of oathbound intervention but never becomes a controllable unit.
personality: Grim, warm only after courage is proven, allergic to excuses.
physicalDescription: Weathered warrior-sage with rune-carved cloak plates, braided iron-gray hair, storm-lit eye scar, and a heavy witness staff.
gameplayFunction: Mission victory witness, oath challenge giver, Asgardian lore unlock source.

name: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
firstAppearance: Campaign 02: Trial of the Celestial Heights
lore: Lyrion designs divine contests to measure whether Titans deserve passage through contested Gates. He frames battles as tests of excellence rather than simple survival.
personality: Elegant, proud, theatrical, dangerous when dishonored.
physicalDescription: Marble-skinned envoy with bronze laurel crown, star-thread mantle, sculptural golden mask, and hovering victory tablets.
gameplayFunction: Challenge mission narrator, objective modifier source, Olympian codex voice.

name: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
lore: Sayo reads how invisible shrine paths fold around Titan Gates. Her maps show safe passage, forbidden crossings, and where battlefields will shift after spirit disturbances.
physicalDescription: Shrine cartographer in layered dark lacquer robes, white fox mask at the hip, ink-brush compass, spirit-paper ribbons floating around map scrolls.
gameplayFunction: Map briefing source, terrain warning voice, Kami lore unlock source.

name: Maeve Root-Memory
lore: Maeve is not fully mortal and not fully tree-spirit; she remembers every Gate scar cut into Avalora. Her warnings prevent living terrain from being treated like ordinary ground.
personality: Patient, sorrowful, quietly terrifying when the forest is wounded.
physicalDescription: Ancient druid-queen figure with bark-silver skin, emerald eyes, antlered crown of living branches, and moss-threaded robes.
gameplayFunction: Living terrain tutorial, Tuatha codex source, campaign moral witness.

name: Oriel Edict-Keeper
firstAppearance: Campaign 02: Trial of the Celestial Heights
lore: Oriel stores verdicts about which Realms may intervene when Gates destabilize. Oriel is not a hero; Oriel is a lawful voice inside the hierarchy of radiant survival.
personality: Calm, absolute, compassionate only inside the limits of law.
physicalDescription: Androgynous celestial official with halo-spine geometry, white-gold armor robes, luminous scroll wings, and a faceless law-mask.
gameplayFunction: Rule explanation, deployment restriction voice, Empyrean codex source.

name: Vasha Cinder-Broker
lore: Vasha sells inbattle line about Dominion power struggles and Gate wounds. Every bargain is useful and dangerous. Vasha never joins the strike force; she exists to tempt, warn, and expose infernal hierarchy.
personality: Amused, ruthless, perceptive, never generous without a hook.
physicalDescription: Infernal court broker with black-iron jewelry, ember-veined skin, ash silk cloak, hornlets, and a ledger that smokes when opened.
gameplayFunction: Risk/reward mission briefing, Infernal codex source, campaign bargain interface.

name: The Unnamed Hollow Mouth
lore: The Hollow Mouth speaks from Gate wounds where identity has been erased. It is not a Realm civilization. It is the sound left after names, oaths, laws, and memories are consumed.
personality: Patient, echoing, invasive, incapable of honest creation.
physicalDescription: A robed absence filled with broken mask fragments, ink-black void skin, white slit-mouths appearing across its veil, and erased symbols orbiting it.
gameplayFunction: Campaign antagonist voice, Hollow event trigger, corruption warning.
